text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - go.mod
      - go.sum
      - .golangci.yml
      - .github/workflows/lint.yml

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          make install-golangci-lint

      - name: Run linters
        run: make lint
```
